title: Computer Vision/Machine Learning Intern
raw_description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

KLA is seeking applications for an Computer Vision/Machine Learning intern in Ebeam division to research and prototype cutting edge image processing and machine learning algorithms for our next-gen products.

We are one of the pioneering companies in the Semi-Conductor industry to use Deep Learning algorithms for defect detection and classification. In addition, we are actively exploring using Generative/Diffusion models for SEM image simulation and image quality enhancement.

Required Qualifications:

- Working experience in one or more of the following: Image Processing, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Deep Learning and applications to 1-D or 2-D signals such as Image Restoration, Detection, or Classification.

- Working knowledge in one of the following SW: Tensorflow, Pytorch, Python, MATLAB.

Minimum Qualifications

- Students working towards a Master's or PhD Level Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related field.

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

title: Robotics Research, Embodied AI Intern (Spring & Summer 2027)
raw_description:
FieldAI’s Irvine team is where embodied AI meets real robots, real sensors, and real field deployments. Based in the heart of Southern California’s robotics ecosystem, we build risk-aware, reliable, field-ready AI systems that solve the hardest problems in robotics and unlock the full potential of embodied intelligence. If you want your work to ship, get tested on hardware, and improve through real deployments, Irvine is the place. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-only architectures, combining rigorous engineering with learning systems proven in globally deployed solutions that deliver results today and get better every time our robots run in the field.

Why Join FieldAI?

FieldAI is tackling one of robotics’ hardest problems: deploying robots in unstructured, previously unknown environments. We are solving one of robotics' hardest challenges: reliable deployment outside the lab. Our Field Foundational Models™ raise the bar for perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, with an emphasis on explainability and safety for real-world use.

You will work alongside a world-class team that values creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. We bring a decade-long track record of real-world deployments, strong performance in DARPA challenges, and experience from organizations such as DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX.

What You'll Do

Depending on your research background and interests, you may work on one or more of the following areas:

-

Robot Behavior & Learning: Research methods for learning, adapting, and generating robot behaviors from demonstrations, interaction, experience, and real-world data, enabling robots to perform long-horizon tasks in dynamic and unstructured environments.

-

Active Perception & Embodied Reasoning: Develop methods that enable robots to actively reason about what to inspect, where to observe, and what actions to take next based on task objectives, observations, uncertainty, and environmental context.

-

Human-Robot Interaction: Develop approaches for intuitive human-robot collaboration, including natural task specification, interactive robot behaviors, human-in-the-loop reasoning, and adaptation to user intent and feedback.

-

Embodied AI Models: Investigate and adapt foundation models, including vision-language models, vision-language-action models, and world models, for reasoning, planning, interaction, and decision-making on physical robots.

-

Real-Robot Experimentation: Implement and evaluate research algorithms on robotic platforms operating in realistic, unstructured environments, and use deployment data to iteratively improve the underlying methods.

-

Research & Publication: Conduct cutting-edge research in embodied AI and robotics, design rigorous experiments and evaluations, and contribute to publications at leading robotics and AI conferences and journals.

What You Bring

-

Currently pursuing or recently completed a PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

-

Strong research foundation in one or more areas such as robot learning, planning and decision-making, embodied AI, perception, active perception, or human-robot interaction.

title: Research Intern, Frontier Speculative Decoding (Summer 2027)
raw_description:
About the Role

The Speculative Decoding team at Together AI builds the draft models and algorithms that let large language models generate faster without changing their outputs. Our speculators run in production on frontier open models such as DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM. Our work sits at the intersection of model training, inference algorithms and serving systems, and we co-design all three to lower the cost and latency of generation.

As a research intern, you will dive into open questions in speculative decoding: new drafter architectures and verification schemes, knowledge distillation and training recipes that align draft and target models, and drafters that adapt as traffic shifts. You will train and fine-tune draft models at scale on dedicated GPU clusters, and test your ideas against realistic serving workloads, including long-context and agentic traffic.

Projects aim to answer important research questions in speculative decoding, enabling faster generation on frontier models, drafters that keep pace with changing workloads, and robust, reproducible evaluation under real traffic.

Past Research

Speculative decoding research by Together researchers, interns and academic collaborators includes:

  • Speculative Speculative Decoding (ICLR 2026)
  • When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System (ICML 2026)
  • Beat the Long Tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training (MLSys 2026)

Responsibilities

  • Research and prototype new efficient speculative decoding algorithms and draft model architectures
  • Train, fine-tune and distill draft models, and design rigorous experiments to validate hypotheses.
  • Implement optimized version for serving engines to show efficacy in real world workloads
  • Communicate the plans, progress, and results of projects to the broader team
  • Share findings through technical write-ups and blog posts, and help bring successful ideas into production

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
  • Strong knowledge of Machine Learning and Deep Learning fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning large models with distributed training frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, FSDP)
  • Familiarity with modern model architectures, such as Mixture-of-Experts and hybrid attention

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior research experience in speculative decoding, efficient inference, or efficient machine learning
  • Publications at leading conferences in machine learning or systems (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys)
  • Experience with knowledge distillation, post-training, or reinforcement learning
  • Familiarity with LLM serving engines (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM)
  • Contributions to open-source machine learning projects

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

Internship Program Details

Our internship program runs 12 to 14 weeks, giving you the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading engineers and researchers across multiple teams. This cohort's internship dates span May 17th to August 6th or June 14th to September 3rd.

We offer competitive compensation, housing stipends, and other competitive benefits. The estimated US hourly rate for this role is $58 - $70 an hour. title: Software Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
raw_description:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying.

At Klaviyo, our Engineering teams build scalable, high-performance systems that power both our product and the infrastructure behind it. As a Software Engineering Intern, you'll be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team whose work reaches thousands of customers worldwide. You won't just be writing code. You'll be solving hard problems, shaping how users experience our product, and learning from engineers who've been doing this for a while.

This internship is your shot to put your software development skills to work in production. You'll be embedded on one of our engineering teams (see overviews below), take on projects that matter to our customers, and build a technical foundation as you make connections across the business.

Our interns come from all kinds of coding backgrounds, but they all share one thing: they're excited to build, own, and scale features end-to-end, from scratch. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, take on hard technical problems, and ship code that supports Klaviyo's mission. We're an AI-first company, so you'll be expected to use AI tools to support your work, learn faster, and do your best work here.

How you'll make an impact

  • Own features that our 180K+ paying customers rely on daily to reach their consumers and grow their business.
  • Take responsibility for the mission, technical direction, and operation of projects with immediate impact.
  • Own the full lifecycle of your code: writing it, testing it, shipping it, and making it better over time. Ownership is expected here, not just encouraged.
  • Build and ship features that meet a high bar and grow your technical skills while you do it.
  • Get hands-on debugging real issues, both locally and in production.
  • Contribute to documentation and support your team during incidents (real-world problems teach you things a tutorial never will).
  • Work closely with your teammates: ask questions, share ideas, and get better by taking feedback seriously.
  • Learn to use the right tool for the job, lean into AI, and keep looking for ways to make things better.
  • Put AI at the center of how you work to move faster. Build smarter systems and better workflows from the ground up.

Who you are

  • At least one previous software engineering internship or co-op, with hands-on software development experience
  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math/Statistics, or a related field
  • Graduating in December 2027 or May/June 2028
  • Experience with some of these technologies and languages:
    • Python, Django, Typescript, React, Go
    • MySQL, Cassandra, Clickhouse, Kafka, Redis
    • Amazon Web Services (EC2, RDS, Aurora, etc.), Terraform
  • You enjoy working across new technologies and you’re excited  to work across the stack from back-end to front-end work
  • You love digging into performance and scalability issues to find breakthrough solutions: a slow-loading UI, too many clicks in a workflow, a database query timing out, a queue that won't drain. You believe every problem can be solved, and you'd rather run toward it than around it.
  • You enjoy shipping code early and often, working closely with products to build better software based on feedback from thousands of end users.
  • You embrace Klaviyo's "always learning" culture. We learn faster together, which is part of why this program happens in person.
  • You've already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you're excited to find ways to make your work smarter and more efficient.

Internship logistics

  • Our Summer Internship Program is an 11-week paid experience [June 1–August 13] at our Boston, MA headquarters. Interns are in office 5 days a week.
  • Offers will be team agnostic - interns are placed on a team approximately 30 days from the start of the program. Team placement can be on a full-stack, back-end, or front-end team within any of the pillars.
  • Before joining individual teams, all interns go through Klaviyo Base Camp, our onboarding experience built to get you up to speed on Klaviyo, our product, and the day-to-day of engineering here, plus time to get to know the other interns. You'll join your team ready to dive into real project work from day one.
  • Our Boston office is genuinely fun. Lunch is on us 5 days a week, along with free snacks and drinks, ping pong, Nintendo Switch, a golf simulator, and a speakeasy to unwind in.
  • Throughout the summer, interns get together for social events beyond team and project work: a Red Sox game, a Boston Harbor Cruise, trips to Kings and Versus, ice cream socials, and Ask Me Anything sessions with Klaviyo's senior leadership.
  • Apply before October 7 if you can. We interview and hire on a rolling basis.

Former intern projects

  • Built a new 'Share Inbox Preview' feature allowing users to generate public share links from the Email Editor.
  • Implemented an 'Invite Expiration Extension' endpoint in IAM with basic logging and validation.
  • Created a small dashboard that displays real-time delivery stats using existing API data and simple visualizations.
  • Migrated one internal service from Jenkins → Buildkite and documented the migration process.
  • Added an image and carousel support for WhatsApp Templates ensuring backward compatibility.

Engineering at Klaviyo

Our engineering teams are organized into pillars to keep the work focused.

  • Data Infrastructure: Empower our internal teams and customers to get the best out of our data and agent platforms. underlying capabilities: Agent Platform, CDP revenue, Data Lake usage, Active API endpoints, Accounts with healthy API usage
  • MCMI: Own the growth, revenue, and reliability of our mobile channels and all messaging infrastructure.
  • Core Infrastructure: Empower our internal engineering, sales, and service teams to be as effective as possible by improving productivity of the eng, product, and design teams.
  • Growth Marketing Platform: Give marketers the tools they need to engage with their customers, be successful, and know where they stand.
  • AI & Analytics: Applies AI, data, and analytics to automate work, surface insights, and help customers make smarter decisions that maximize Klaviyo Attributed Value (KAV).
  • Autonomous Service: Builds AI-powered customer service experiences that help resolve issues, support transactions, and connect customers with human assistance when needed.

If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't check every box, apply anyway. Some of the strongest Klaviyos didn't start with a perfect resume match.

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

raw_description:
ABOUT METAMORPHIC

Metamorphic is developing new approaches to intelligence by combining machine learning with large-scale experimental neuroscience, informed by the principles that make the brain efficient, flexible, and robust. We are building foundation models trained on rich, continuous neural data — a high-resolution model of the brain at a scale never before possible.

Our founding team spans machine learning, neuroscience, and neurotechnology, with prior work including the MICrONS project https://www.nature.com/immersive/d42859-025-00001-w/index.html, Neuropixels http://neuropixels.org/, and the Enigma project https://www.enigmaproject.ai/, as well as foundational scientific contributions in learning, neural computation, and generative modeling. Our work sits at the frontier of AI research, and we believe the highest-impact discoveries will come from researchers and engineers working as a single, tightly collaborative team.

The name Metamorphic reflects our belief that the next advances in intelligence will come from a change in form, beyond scale — from artificial to natural intelligence.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking interns across a broad range of roles including computer vision, embodied AI and RL, robotics, agentic systems, language modeling, computational neuroscience, and ML engineering to join our growing AI research team for the summer. This is a high-impact, technically deep role at the frontier of ML research and engineering in an early stage company.

You'll thrive in this role if you:

- Have the ability to move from research code to production-quality systems

- Are a pragmatic problem solver with attention to scalability and reliability

- Are comfortable operating in fast-moving, research-driven environments

- Are eager to learn more about machine learning research in a novel scientific domain

- Are enthusiastic to work at an organization that functions as a single, cohesive team pursuing large-scale AI research

- Have ambitious goals for AI progress and are excited to create the best outcomes over the long term

We offer:

- The chance to work on one of the most scientifically consequential AI projects being pursued today

- A small, world-class team where your contributions directly shape the science and the company

- Competitive compensation and benefits

- Strong mentorship and career development

SALARY RANGE

$6-8k/month depending on seniority.

TIMELINE

Application Deadline: November 10th, 2026

Interviews: November 11th - November 26th, 2026

Decision Release: December 1st, 2026

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, currently pursuing a PhD or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or another quantitative field

- Strong interest in one of the below:

- Computer vision

- Embodied AI and RL

- Agentic systems

- Robotics

- Language

- ML engineering

- Computational neuroscience

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience conducting long-term development and/or research projects in academia or industry

- Contributions to open-source ML projects

- Publications at top-tier conferences

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. If you don't see a role that fits, we encourage you to submit a general application and tell us how you'd like to contribute to our mission.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce AI Research is a global leader in Enterprise AI, driving innovations that advance the state of AI while powering enterprise products at worldwide scale.

Our research has helped shape multiple generations of modern AI: we helped pioneer prompt engineering through DecaNLP; introduced BLIP, a foundational breakthrough in multimodal AI; trained state-of-the-art large language models including CodeGen; and pioneered foundation models for time series with Moirai. Today, we continue to advance the frontier of enterprise AI through innovations in AI simulation environments like eVerse, our simulation and agent-training environment; the Atlas Reasoning Engine, which powers Agentforce reasoning capabilities; and other AI systems that are redefining how enterprises reason, plan, and act.

What makes our team unique is our ability to take ideas from research to real-world impact at scale. We work closely with product teams and enterprise customers to translate cutting-edge research into production AI capabilities used by millions of users. We also continue to publish at the world's top AI conferences, open source influential research, and collaborate with leading academic institutions. Learn more at Salesforce AI Research.

We are looking for entrepreneurial Research Interns for Summer 2027 who want to help build the next generation of Enterprise AI. This is not a traditional research internship. You will work like a founder within Salesforce: exploring high-impact research directions, prototyping cutting-edge AI capabilities, and seeing how ideas are validated with customers and turned into production-ready solutions. You will have the freedom to propose and explore new ideas, alongside mentors and research scientists, with access to Salesforce's global customer and product ecosystem. We are looking for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, bring energy and focus to their work, and care as much about customer adoption as technical innovation. If you want the pace and ownership of a startup, combined with the reach and resources of Salesforce, this internship offers a unique opportunity to do research with global impact.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Collaborate with research scientists and engineers on a project focused on real-world product impact, with the opportunity to publish your work at top-tier conferences.

- Explore research directions with the potential to transform Enterprise AI.

- Help turn promising ideas into zero-to-one AI product prototypes.

- Build models, agents, and AI systems for real-world enterprise use.

- Learn how research partners with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to bring solutions to market.

You're Our Person If...

- You have a strong publication record at top AI venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CVPR, ICCV, ACL, EMNLP) and/or experience building AI research into real-world systems.

- You have experience with Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or DeepSpeed.

- You are motivated by real-world impact and care about seeing your research leave the lab and reach users at scale.

- You bring expertise in one or more core focus areas:

- Agentic AI and Reasoning: LLM-powered agents, reinforcement learning (RL), reasoning and planning, autonomous workflows, computer use agents, deep research agents, and coding agents.

- Multimodal and Computer Vision: Vision-language models, video understanding, and multimodal AI agents.

- Speech Intelligence: Voice intelligence, text-to-speech/automatic speech recognition, and low-latency audio processing.

- Core Modeling and Post-Training: Pre-training and post-training techniques including RLHF and direct preference optimization, model distillation, evaluation, and time series modeling.

- You can conduct research with guidance from mentors, and you are ready to grow toward independence and translate ideas into impactful systems.

Even Better If...

- You are a PhD or MS candidate in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.

- You have experience building and scaling ML models for real-world applications.

- You have strong programming skills (competitive programming, e.g., ACM-ICPC, or open source experience).

- You are thoughtful about responsible AI, trust, and the real-world impact of the systems you build.

- You are a fantastic problem solver, able to tackle challenges the world hasn't solved before.

- You have excellent written and spoken communication skills.

- You collaborate effectively with teammates.

Internship Details

This is a Summer 2027 internship with a minimum duration of 12 weeks.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Key Role Details

- This is a full-time paid internship program spanning twelve weeks from June through August.

- Participation in the internship requires that you are located in the continental United States with in-person attendance at your assigned location, in accordance with Capital One’s hybrid working model, for the duration of the program.

- Interns will be evaluated for a full-time position with their team and will work with their manager on identifying a start date upon graduation.

This is a paid internship. This is a limited-time internship position, and Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position. However, a full-time AI Engineering role, for which you may be considered upon completion of the internship (subject to business need, market conditions, and other factors) is eligible for employer immigration sponsorship.

Basic Qualifications

- Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained by August 2028 or earlier.

- Must be continuing in the same course of study of the most recent degree following completion of the internship period.

- At least 6 months of experience or academic work developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies.

- At least 6 months of experience or academic work programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience or academic work with deploying AI/ML systems on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).

- Experience or academic work in developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing AI/ML training or inference pipelines, including distributed GPU computational frameworks.

- Experience or academic work with AI/ML domains and systems (e.g., LLM Inference, Search and Retrieval, NLP, Computer Vision, Guardrails, Memory).

- Familiarity with Agentic Frameworks (Eg: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Autogen, MCP/A2A, frontier-labs agent SDKs).

AI Engineering Internship

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing deep personalization and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

Join the AI Engineering Internship Program for a specialized summer experience that directly contributes to delivering industry-leading agentic capabilities and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. As part of this team, you'll help build Agentic AI applications and platform capabilities that power customer-facing experiences with GenAI workflows, industry-leading infrastructure, and internal agentic coding tools. You'll work on the Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team, which is tasked with advancing the state-of-the-art in AI science and engineering. You’ll make valuable contributions from day one by building AI systems and shaping ideas key to delivering AI-native experiences and products for our 100mm+ customers.

In this role, you will:

- Partner deeply with a cross-functional team of research scientists, PMs, and engineers to prototype and ship AI-native products that reach millions of customers.

- Research, prototype, and productionalize high-impact AI systems, including multimodal search, intelligent document processing, and autonomous agentic workflows that push the boundaries of current industry benchmarks.

- Design and optimize the critical infrastructure of our AI stack—from fine-tuning pre-training pipelines and reinforcement learning to implementing inference optimization, robust guardrails and sophisticated evaluation frameworks.

- Leverage a broad stack of technologies including AWS Ultraclusters, PyTorch, and leading-edge agentic frameworks. You’ll be empowered with top-tier developer tools like Claude Code and Windsurf to accelerate the path from concept to code.

- Architect agentic workflows that go beyond simple chat—enabling AI systems to autonomously navigate tools, orchestrate multi-step reasoning, and integrate seamlessly with complex microservice environments.

The Ideal Candidate:

- You are curious, love to build systems, and also share our passion to do it the right way. You want to work on problems that have not been attempted before and will help change banking for good.

- You move fluently from reading a research paper to implementing it in production. You have a deep, intuitive grasp of the latest advances in agentic workflows and multimodal models.

- You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity.

- You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enable you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss.

- You excel at decomposing complex problems. You possess the judgment to decide where AI adds value and how to orchestrate AI workflows incorporating time-tested systems design principles, integrating both into a unified whole.

title: Software Engineering Internship - Summer 2027
raw_description:
We are looking for motivated and talented students who want to help us solve some of the most complex challenges in financial technology. Technology teams at CME Group write and maintain ultra low-latency electronic trading platforms, risk management systems, and front-end trading interfaces, all of which are central to CME Group’s business. We are focused on designing, building, and deploying customer-focused solutions with passion and precision.

CME Group Technology interns will gain unparalleled exposure to electronic trading and financial technology. Interns will have the opportunity to work on a variety of applications and projects that directly impact the global trading ecosystem. In the past, our interns have worked on building cloud infrastructure, enhancing market architecture, designing AI agents, and taking ownership of new applications that can change the trading lifecycle. Interns are likely to work in the areas of back-end or full-stack development, cloud computing, application resiliency, and automation.

CME Group’s Technology Internship Program offers students opportunities to learn more about our enterprise, our role in the financial industry, and the types of technology that keep our markets running. Students will develop their technical skills and expand their network with access to industry experts, while working alongside other talented and ambitious students with a passion for FinTech.

Interns can participate in several core roles, including:

-
Application Development

-
Cloud Infrastructure & Migration

-
Data Analytics

-
DevOps & CI/CD

-
Research & Proof of Concept

-
System Design

These summer internships are paid, full-time roles that typically last 10-12 weeks. They are hybrid roles, typically based out of our Chicago office. The summer program includes numerous opportunities to network with peers from across the country during a summer full of experiences such as excursions to enjoy Chicago traditions, trading and coding challenges with prizes, lunch and learn speaker series, and other opportunities for professional development.

Minimum qualifications:

-
Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in computer science or a related field

-
Proficiency in Java and/or Python

-
Passionate about problem-solving and continuous learning

-
Strong communication skills

-
Detail-oriented

​

Bonus qualifications:

-
Previous technical experience

-
Strong knowledge of cloud computing services, specifically GCP

-
Experience with Docker/Kubernetes, Git, IDEs/IntelliJ, Linux/UNIX, Maven, REST APIs, SQL, unit testing

Qualified candidates will be invited to complete a coding pre-assessment. If selected to advance, candidates may be invited to virtual coding, design, and behavioral interviews.

Sponsorship Qualifications:

Please note that our company is unable to provide employment sponsorship for this position and can only consider candidates who are legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship assistance (CPT, H1B, F1, L, etc.).
CME Group is committed to offering a competitive pay package for our employee interns. The pay range typically applicable to our intern roles is $21.68--$36.10. Actual pay offered will be dependent on a wide array of factors including but not limited to: relevant experience, skills, education, location of the internship, and the internship area of focus. Through our benefits program, we offer our employee interns the opportunity to participate in select offerings. This includes our comprehensive health coverage and a mental health benefit.
CME Group: Where Futures are Made

CME Group is the world’s leading derivatives marketplace. But who we are goes deeper than that. Here, you can impact markets worldwide. Transform industries. And build a career by shaping tomorrow. We invest in your success and you own it – all while working alongside a team of leading experts who inspire you in ways big and small. Problem solvers, difference makers, trailblazers. Those are our people. And we’re looking for more.

At CME Group, we embrace our employees' unique experiences and skills to ensure that everyone’s perspectives are acknowledged and valued. As an equal-opportunity employer, we consider all potential employees without regard to any protected characteristic.

Important Notice: Recruitment fraud is on the rise, with scammers using misleading promises of job offers and interviews to solicit money and personal information from job seekers. CME Group adheres to established procedures designed to maintain trust, confidence and security throughout our recruitment process. Learn more here.

Artificial Intelligence • Cloud • HR Tech • Information Technology • Productivity • Software • Automation

We're putting AI to work for people.

The Role

Full-stack Software Development Engineer Intern building end-to-end features across front-end, back-end, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and AI-integrated components. Responsibilities include system design, coding, testing, code review, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, production monitoring, incident response, and collaboration with product managers, designers, and engineers. Interns will use AI coding assistants and LLM APIs while evaluating generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.

Summary Generated by Built In

Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

As a full stack Software Development Engineer Intern, you'll help design, build, and maintain software across the entire application stack from user-facing interfaces to APIs, data stores, and cloud infrastructure. You'll write well-tested, maintainable code, participate actively in code review, and use AI coding assistants to accelerate delivery while critically evaluating AI-generated output for correctness and security. Strong collaboration with product managers, designers, and peer engineers is essential to create resilient, scalable solutions.

What you do

- Full Software Development Lifecycle:

- Build features end-to-end—from design through deployment—building front-end (React/Angular/Vue) and back-end (REST/GraphQL, microservices) solutions

- System Design & Architecture

- Contribute to scalable system design: evaluate architectural trade-offs, define data models and API contracts, and choose the right cloud-native and persistence strategies for your project

- Code Quality Testing and Review

- Write comprehensive tests, uphold coding standards, and review code—including AI-generated code—for security, performance, and maintainability.

- Develop, maintain, and execute automated test suites to validate software functionality, catch defects early.

- CI/CD, DevOps & Operational Readiness

- Maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code, monitor systems in production, and participate in incident response including AI-integrated components.

- Cross Functional Collaboration & Technical Communication

- Partner with product managers, designers, and platform teams to scope and deliver features, writing clear specs and communicating trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

We hire in multiple locations including but not limited to: Santa Clara, CA, San Diego, CA, Kirkland, WA, West Palm Beach, FL and other geographical areas. Work location will be determined based on team growth strategies.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

- Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Computer Science, or related field; with a graduation date no earlier than May 2028

- Must be available to work full-time hours, for a 12- week period, either May – August or June – September in 2027

- Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

- Full-stack development skills: Hands on experience through coursework, research, projects, or internships with front-end frameworks (React/Angular/Vue), back-end languages (Node.js, Python, Java, Go), databases, REST/GraphQL APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), plus comfort adopting emerging AI/ML tools.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Systems thinking: Understanding of trade-offs between consistency, availability, and performance, and working knowledge of distributed system patterns and API/database design.

- Working knowledge of software engineering fundamentals: Prior experience writing clean, secure, well-tested code and examples of treating code review as a quality practice.

- AI fluency: Effectively incorporates AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Codeium, etc) and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight models) to build features, and applies sound judgment when reviewing AI-generated code for correctness and security.

- Technical communication: Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans and communicate trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

We know great candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If you’re excited about this opportunity and meet the minimum qualifications, we encourage you to apply.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $58.96/hour, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Additional Information

All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Meaningful Project Work: Every Intern is assigned a project that delivers value to the business.

Tokyo Electron (TEL) is a leader in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. We provide key parts of the manufacturing process for the world’s largest foundries. TEL Technology AI and Design Inc is our Silicon Valley AI lab, where we do groundbreaking, long-term research and technology development in AI/ML for semiconductor equipment.

We are looking for a new team member who can contribute to our AI research roadmap.

TTAD fosters a creative culture where ideas are freely exchanged inside our lab and with our colleagues around the world.

- Creative, out-of-the-box thinker

- Good communicator who works well in a team and across cultural barriers

- Low prestige problem solver: willing to be wrong and accept a better solution

- Productive in translating ideas to code

- Present to support colleagues – gives freely of own time

- Interested in learning, e.g. a complex application domain, new programming languages

Role Requirements

- Proficiency in Python and/or C/C++; ability to read and modify existing codebases.

- High proficiency in algorithmic thinking and software development

- High familiarity with current AI approaches and research

- Clear written and verbal communication for producing technical deliverables.

- Graduate level (M.S. or Ph.D.) preferred, strong candidates who are rising Junior or Senior level Bachelor’s level students in the named fields will be considered

Role Responsibilities

- Drive development of assigned research tasks

- Research and propose solutions to assigned research topics

- Convert ideas to code in a productive and flexible manner, in existing and new code bases

- Actively contribute to TTAD knowledge accumulation by sharing research topics and insights with team

Coinbase is on a mission to increase economic freedom for more than 1 billion people.

The Role

Twelve-week software engineering internship building production crypto and blockchain products at Coinbase. Interns write tested code, collaborate with engineering, design, and product teams, participate in code reviews, own an end-to-end project, and learn blockchain concepts. Candidates need programming experience, problem-solving ability, familiarity with web, mobile, backend, or infrastructure development, and responsible generative AI usage with human oversight.

Summary Generated by Built In

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

This is a 12-week internship during summer 2027.

You'll join Coinbase as a software engineer intern and help build the next generation of crypto-forward products and features. You'll solve large-scale, complex technical problems at the intersection of web-scale applications and blockchain technology, shipping real code that impacts millions of users.

During the application process, you'll select your preferred team from the groups below. Your application will be primarily considered for your selected team in the specified location. Following the hybrid internship, any full-time return opportunity would be remote-first.

Product Group Teams (internship location = San Francisco):

- Base - Scale the crypto economy by creating integrations, fiat onramps, and developer tools on Coinbase's Ethereum L2 network, connecting builders to 108M+ users and $100B+ in assets.

- Consumer - Build the fastest way to access crypto through the Coinbase retail and wallet apps, advanced trade, dApps, and staking.

- Developer - Help build out Coinbase Developer Platform - trusted crypto infrastructure at scale. Payments, Wallets, Trading, and Stablecoin APIs for the global financial system.

- Institutional - Enable thousands of large financial institutions to securely custody digital assets, stake, and participate in the crypto economy.

- Platform - Create the scalable, compliant foundational systems (Identity, FinHub, Payments, Blockchain and Infrastructure) that underpin all Coinbase products.

Core Teams (internship location = New York City):

- Security - Build solutions for critical security, compliance, and privacy needs, including the Workforce IAM Platform and security oversight tooling.

- Enterprise Engineering (EE) - Develop platforms that enhance customer support, internal tools and compliance through automation and customer-first engineering.

What you'll do:

- Write high-quality, well-tested code that ships to production and directly impacts Coinbase customers.

- Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers to turn technical and product vision into delivered features.

- Participate in code reviews, providing and receiving feedback that raises the quality bar for your team.

- Own a defined project end-to-end, from scoping through implementation and launch, within your 12-week internship.

- Learn and apply crypto and blockchain domain concepts to real engineering problems in a production environment.

Required Skills and Experience:

- Demonstrates the ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots (e.g., LibreChat, Gemini, Glean) in daily workflows, continuously learn as tools evolve, and apply human‑in‑the‑loop practices to deliver business‑ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, and quality.

- Programming experience in any language (academic, personal projects, or professional).

- Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous problems into concrete implementation steps.

- Familiarity with at least one of: web development, mobile development, backend systems, or infrastructure.

- Utilize generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

PID: GETR-PSWE00US-Q326

Pay Transparency Notice: Depending on your work location, the target hourly rate for this position can range as detailed below.

Hourly Rate:

$60—$60 USD

Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

- Ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots, including human-in-the-loop practices

- Programming experience in any language through academic, personal, or professional work

- Ability to break down ambiguous problems into concrete implementation steps

- Familiarity with web development, mobile development, backend systems, or infrastructure

What the Team is Saying

Jona Frank

Staff Software Engineer

People rarely get the chance to be a part of history that’s being scripted. Being a part of Coinbase gives me that opportunity exactly. Aiding, developing and shaping up the future of the global financial system is what we do. Knowing that your work directly contributes towards how things evolve is the most satisfying aspect of working here!

Wes Janisen

Senior Manager, Integrated Marketing

Even though we are this big, publicly traded company with thousands of employees, we’ve still managed to have the kind of agility and innovative spirit of a startup!

Sofia Sieminski

Staff Accountant, Platform

As a former intern, I can confidently say that the Coinbase intern program is phenomenal! A major focus of my work was on automation, and many of the automated workbooks I enhanced are still in use today. I’ve maintained strong friendships with my intern class, and I’m thrilled to return as a full-time Digital Asset Platform Accountant.

Philip Temitayo

Chief Risk Officer

I’m part of an incredibly talented team that’s driving a risk-focused culture to ensure that crypto as an asset class is as safe as possible for customers.

Varsha Mahadevan

Director, Machine Learning

Clear communication at Coinbase has a special mantle. It is unparalleled with anything I have seen prior. I dare say Coinbase has nearly perfected the remote work arrangement!

Coinbase Compensation & Benefits Highlights

How does Coinbase ensure its pay and bonus plans are competitive?

Coinbase uses a market-driven, pay-for-performance approach to keep pay and bonus plans competitive. Coinbase regularly benchmarks roles against leading technology and fintech companies using external market data and reviews its compensation programs on a recurring basis to ensure salary, bonus, and equity remain aligned with the broader market and business goals. Annual bonus and equity programs are tied to both company results and individual impact, so when Coinbase and its people perform, total rewards reflect that performance.

title: Software Engineer, Intern (Summer 2027)
raw_description:
About Persona

Persona is the configurable identity platform built for businesses in a digital-first world. Verifying individuals and organizations is harder — but more important — than ever, with AI enabling fraudsters to launch sophisticated accounts at scale and regulations evolving rapidly.

We’ve built Persona to support practically every use case and industry — that’s why we’re able to serve a wide range of leading companies. For example, Reddit relies on Persona for age assurance and verification to comply with online safety regulations, protecting younger users while maintaining a seamless experience. Meanwhile, OpenAI relies on Persona to keep bad actors out, protecting one of the world’s most powerful AI platforms from large-scale abuse in a time when AI is reshaping the way we work and live.

We’re growing rapidly and looking for exceptional people to join us!

Our Engineering team and internship program This is not your typical engineering internship. During your internship, you'll have opportunities for ownership that will significantly build your confidence as a software engineer. At one of the fastest-growing startups in technology, you'll ship code as early as your first week! You'll receive dedicated 1:1 mentorship, along with challenging technical assignments, novel product feature work, and many opportunities to stretch your technical skills unlike ever before. We’re building both a product and a technology, but doing whatever it takes isn’t always straightforward. This role will help show you how to build the correct systems for scale, while also building something that customers want.

What you'll learn

-
Build and ship: You'll design foundational aspects of the identity platform

-
Partner with customers: Work directly with customers to understand their pain points and build product features for them. You’re in the driver's seat to get your project in front of real customers

-
See (and ship) scale: Handle both first-time and long-time customers running a CSV data test at Super Bowl Sunday scale

-
Cross-team collaboration: Discuss the unique aspects of your projects with teams such as product, design, post-sales, and sales

-
Continuous learning: Work with your mentor and a close-knit team to ensure your learnings from past projects are brought into future projects, helping you grow quickly as an engineer

What you'll bring to Persona

-
Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in computer science, engineering, math, or related discipline with a strong CS background

-
Previous programming experience is a must. While we use Ruby/Rails, Typescript, React, Redux, Android, iOS, and Python, we care more about engineering skills than knowledge of specific languages or frameworks

-
Proficiency in full-stack development, previous experience with data modeling and schema design

-
Ability to work independently and collaboratively to execute projects and adhere to deadlines - Eager to discuss positive and negative feedback regarding large projects

-
Willing to be in-person in San Francisco and work out of our San Francisco office Tuesday - Thursdays (WFH option Mondays and Fridays)

-
You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment

At Persona, we believe in people above all else. We strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone's contributions are valued and their growth is supported. We're honored to be recognized as one of Fortune's Best Medium Workplaces, a testament to our commitment to fostering a world-class team. You can read what it’s like to work at Persona on Glassdoor or visit our Early Careers page to see more opportunities like this one.

Benefits and Perks

For full-time US-based employees (excluding internship and contractor opportunities), Persona offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision, 3% 401(k) contribution, unlimited PTO, quarterly mental health days, family planning benefits, professional development stipend, wellness benefits, among others.

For full-time UK employees, Persona offers a wide range of benefits, including private medical insurance, dental insurance, a 6% employer pension contribution, unlimited PTO, a monthly wellness stipend, professional development stipend, co-working stipend, and more.

As part of our interview process, all candidates will be asked to verify their identity with Persona. This step is used solely to confirm that candidates are who they say they are, and will have no impact on hiring decisions.

title: Platform Engineer Intern, Summer 2027
raw_description:
About Akuna:

Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions, and automation. We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market maker, meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully, we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies, and mathematical models.

Our Founding Partners first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Sydney, Shanghai, Singapore, and London.

What you’ll do as a Platform Engineer Intern at Akuna:

We are seeking Platform Engineer Interns to join our innovative and growing technology team for our 10-week Akunacademy internship program. You will work within the Platform Engineering Team, gaining expertise through building highly automated operations while monitoring and managing the operational capabilities of systems at Akuna. Each intern takes full ownership of their project, and at the end of the program, has the opportunity to present their work and accomplishments. In this role, you will:

- Support and design the ongoing growth, design, and expansion of our Platform offerings to meet the needs of our internal stakeholders with scalable, reliable, and highly available systems
- Work with our steam aligned and partner platform teams to develop our hybrid cloud platform
- Produce clean, well-tested, and documented code with a clear design to support production infrastructure and systems
- Challenge the status quo and help push our organization forward, as we grow beyond the limits of our current tech stack

Requirements for this role:

- Pursuing a bachelor’s, master’s, or Ph.D. in a technical field (computer science/engineering, math, physics, or equivalent)
- Graduating by August 2028
- Major GPA of 3.5 or above
- Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required on the first day of employment including F-1 students using OPT or STEM

Previous experience in finance or trading is not required. Many of our engineers joined Akuna with little-to-no prior knowledge of the markets, and we pride ourselves on our ability to onboard those new to the industry. Training and continuous education are provided for all engineers to ensure they can build the requisite technical and non-technical skillset for success.

Qualities that make great candidates:

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Kubernetes, and AWS Cloud
- Experience with cloud computing, networking, data engineering and security
- Ability to react quickly and accurately to rapidly changing market conditions, including the ability to quickly and accurately respond and/or solve math and coding problems, is an essential function of the role

In addition to the above technical skills, Akuna values diversity of experience and perspective. We believe that engineers with varied backgrounds and interests allow us to approach problems from unique angles and to uncover innovative, optimal solutions. We want everyone to feel empowered to apply; we welcome your application, and we strongly encourage you to take the first steps in joining us in the future!

**Resumes must be submitted in PDF format.

By applying to this role, you are indicating this is your top preference and acknowledge you will not be considered for other Quant and/or Tech roles at Akuna this recruiting season. This acknowledgement does not limit applications to Trading roles - in addition to this role, you may apply to any Trader roles of interest.

We are an AI-friendly company and encourage employees to leverage AI in their daily work. However, AI assistance is not permitted during interviews or assessments. Our interview process is designed to evaluate your individual skills and judgment, and the use of AI tools will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

In accordance with the Illinois Equal Pay Act, the minimum annualized base salary starts at $145,000. Exact compensation offered may vary based on many factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set. The minimum base salary herein was determined in good faith by Akuna Capital LLC.

title: 2027 Flight Software Engineer Intern
raw_description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We are looking for Flight Software Engineer Interns to join our rapidly growing team! We hire self-motivated people, those who hold a higher bar for themselves than anyone else could hold for them. If you are eager to solve tough problems, then this role might be for you!

Our Flight Engineering department is divided into three critical areas: Flight Software (FSW), Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC), and Modeling, Simulation & Analysis (MSA). As an engineer intern, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside industry experts in one of these areas, contributing to the development and testing of advanced autonomous systems.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Assist in the design and development of flight software algorithms, GNC systems, or simulation models.
- Participate in the integration and testing of software/hardware components in lab, ground, or flight tests.
- Analyze data collected from simulations and flight test events to inform system improvements.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address engineering challenges and enhance system performance.
- Engage in creative problem-solving to advance our UAS and missile technologies.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Must be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- Must be returning to school at the end of the internship to continue academic studies for at least one quarter or semester.
- Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program.
- Ability to complete an in-person 12-week internship in one of our offices in summer 2027.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- A strong foundation in software development (for FSW candidates), control theory (for GNC candidates), or analytical modeling (for MSA candidates).
- Keen interest in autonomous systems, UAS, and missile technology.
- Excellent communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
- Hands-on experience with Design-Build-Fly teams, robotics competition teams (such as FIRST or VEX), or collegiate rocketry groups.
- Credible demonstration of aerospace-related hobbies such as high-power rocketry experience/certification, remotely piloted/semi-autonomous aircraft, or software integration on target hardware such as Raspberry Pi, Pixhawk, CubePilot (such as Cube Orange), or custom microcontrollers, using onboard IMU, GNSS, and Flight Simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SITL) or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) simulation environments.
- Experience with open-source autopilot software suites like ArduPilot or PX4.
- Experience with integrating flight hardware components including servos/actuators, IMUs, magnetometers, GNSS receivers and antennas, and serial communication protocols (such as UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) or radio telemetry links.
- Basic familiarity with electrical test equipment (such as multimeters or oscilloscopes) and post-flight data analysis using tools like Python or MATLAB.

US Hourly Range

$42—$60 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

- No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
- Please always verify communications:
- Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to [redacted].
- Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
- What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to [redacted]. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Software Engineering Intern
raw_description:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

Appian Engineering spans the full depth of our platform—from foundational systems that power enterprise-scale performance, to AI capabilities redefining automation, to the developer tooling that makes it all accessible. We operate in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment focused on technical rigor, continuous learning, and high code quality. As an intern, you will contribute to real engineering work that helps shape how Appian delivers its AI-powered Process Automation platform to enterprises around the world.

As a Software Engineering Intern, you will build on your academic foundation and gain hands-on experience contributing to production-adjacent engineering work. You will be embedded within a small, high-performing team where you’ll learn how modern enterprise software is designed, built, tested, and shipped at scale. You will also work alongside engineers who leverage cutting-edge AI tooling to accelerate development while maintaining strong standards for quality and correctness.

This internship is based at our headquarters in McLean, Virginia. Appian was built on a culture of in-person collaboration, which we believe is a key driver of our mission to be the best. Interns in this program are expected to be in the office 5 days a week to fully experience our culture, learn directly from peers and mentors, and contribute to projects in a collaborative environment. Being in the office provides more opportunities to connect, learn, and celebrate with the exceptional people across Appian.

Applicants considered for Summer 2027 - Students Only

We are building a next-generation global content platform that uses intelligent recommendation, personalisation, and content understanding to help people discover experiences that genuinely matter to them. Backed by AppLovin's world-class AI capabilities and global infrastructure, our ML team is working on some of the most technically interesting problems in the recommendation and content space — at a scale few startups ever reach.
For Summer 2027, we're looking for Machine Learning Engineer Interns who want to work on real ML systems, not toy datasets. You'll contribute to production pipelines across areas like content recommendation, ranking, user modelling, and content quality — depending on where you're placed and where you can make the most impact.

About Gist
Gist is a new social media platform for people who want substance — practical, thoughtful content that spans philosophy debates, city-specific recommendations, seasonal gift guides, and wellness tips. Across categories like travel, food, career, and family, we describe it as "a handbook for the curious."
Gist is built by AppLovin Corporation — a company that hit $5.3B in revenue last year and sits alongside Google and Meta as one of the world's leading ad tech platforms. Fortune recognizes AppLovin as one of the Best Workplaces in the Bay Area, and the company has been a Certified Great Place to Work for the last four years (2021–2024).

About the Team
Our ML team owns the intelligence layer of the platform — the systems that decide what content a user sees, how it's ranked, how new users and new content are onboarded, and how we balance engagement, retention, and ecosystem health over time. It's a highly cross-functional team: you'll work alongside product managers, backend engineers, and data analysts to turn model improvements into measurable business outcomes. As an intern, you'll be embedded in a specific ML workstream with a senior engineer mentor and a project scoped for real production impact.

What You'll Do

- Contribute to the development and evaluation of ML models within a defined area — recommendation, ranking, content understanding, or user behaviour modelling.
- Own a focused internship project end-to-end: problem framing, feature engineering, model training, offline evaluation, and where possible, online experimentation.
- Run experiments and analyse results to form a clear, data-backed view of what's working and why.
- Collaborate with engineers and product managers to understand system constraints and translate model improvements into production-ready solutions.
- Participate in team discussions on model architecture, system design, and metric trade-offs.

Requirements

- Solid foundation in machine learning concepts — supervised learning, model evaluation, optimisation, and the trade-offs between different modelling approaches.
- Proficiency in Python and familiarity with at least one ML framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Comfortable working with data — feature engineering, exploratory analysis, and interpreting experimental results.
- Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean code, version control, and the ability to collaborate on a shared codebase.
- Curious, rigorous, and honest about what the data is actually telling you.

Good To Have

- Any project or coursework experience applying ML to real data — Kaggle competitions, research projects, and course capstones all count.
- Exposure to recommendation systems, ranking, or personalisation concepts — even from an academic or reading background.
- Familiarity with large-scale data tools such as Spark, Hive, or cloud ML platforms.
- Understanding of A/B testing and statistical significance in an experimentation context.
- Interest in content platforms, social products, or AI-driven discovery systems.
